subject: Ops telemetry slimline package - pricing & terms
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Russell <natalie.russell@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops telemetry slimline package - pricing & terms

Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a slimline proposal for AtlasHealth that focuses on: retention (30-day hot + 365-day cold), tracing (sampled full traces at 5%), and the advanced dashboards pack (limited to 10 dashboards).

High-level numbers (monthly, USD):
- Retention (30d hot / 365d cold): $6,500
- Tracing (5% sampling, ingestion): $2,200
- Advanced Dashboards (10 dashboards, shared views): $1,200
- Platform addon subtotal: $9,900
- Proposed discount: 15% for a 12-month commitment -> $8,415/mo

What this includes: prefix/KV caching for inference traces, SLA for retention durability, and rollout support for dashboards.

Attachments: AtlasHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), SOW_line_items.csv (line item breakdown).

Ask: can you confirm whether procurement prefers a single-line monthly SKU or separate line items for tracing and dashboards? If separate, we can provide a PO template they can use.

If this looks good I'll loop in Ben to finalize commercial terms and Kim on legal.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Russell <natalie.russell@atlashealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops telemetry slimline package - pricing & terms

Grace —

Thanks for the detail and quick turnaround. A few items from our side before we move to docs: 

1) Retention: $6.5k/mo for the retention profile is higher than we budgeted. For our expected ingest patterns we were expecting something in the $3k–4k/mo range. Can you run a sensitivity on ingest volume and show a 10% and 25% lower ingest scenario?

2) Tracing: we like the 5% sampling idea, but we need an option for on-demand full-trace capture for customer-impact incidents. Is that a separate metered charge or included?

3) Dashboards: the advanced pack is fine but we need a one-time setup fee split out (professional services) and an option to add two more dashboards at a per-dashboard rate.

Procurement has asked that any discount be captured as either an up-front credit or a committed monthly rate (they prefer single-line SKU). I CC'd them so they can chime in with PO format.

Also — do you have any flexibility on the 15% discount for a 12-month commit? We typically push for 20% on similar telemetry bundles.

Regards,
Natalie Russell
Director, Platform Reliability
AtlasHealth

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Russell <natalie.russell@atlashealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops telemetry slimline package - pricing & terms

Natalie —

Appreciate the candid asks. Short answers and an adjusted commercial path below.

1) Retention sensitivity: we ran the numbers — with 25% lower ingest the retention line drops to $4,900/mo; with 10% lower it drops to $5,600/mo. I'll attach the CSV breakdown (SOW_line_items.csv already attached). Those scenarios assume the same compression/archival cadence.

2) On-demand full-trace capture: available as an ephemeral capture feature. We propose: 500 incident captures/mo included, additional captures at $0.50/capture. We can also offer an elevated incident capture SLA as a one-time add-on ($3,000 for the year) that allows unlimited captures for priority incidents.

3) Dashboards: $1,200 stays as the managed package. Setup (one-time PS) is $4,000 — we'll split that into a one-time fee or amortize it across the first 6 months if you prefer. Additional dashboards after the 10 included are $200/dashboard/mo.

Discount concession: If AtlasHealth signs a 12-month commit and takes the elevated incident capture as part of the contract we can move to 18% off list, or 20% off if you commit to 24 months. As Procurement wants a single-line SKU we can show a consolidated monthly rate and a one-line discount credit on the first invoice to make accounting easier. 

Proposed consolidated monthly examples (illustrative):
- 12-month commit (18%): $8,118/mo (after discount)
- 24-month commit (20%): $7,920/mo (after discount)

If those look ok I can prepare a final SOW and a single-line PO template. Kim — can legal review the SOW for the incident capture language? Jordan — can you confirm the 500 capture inclusion is safe from a performance perspective?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ops telemetry slimline package - pricing & terms

Kim / Jordan —

Forwarding the thread. Key asks from AtlasHealth: lower retention scenarios, on-demand full-trace captures (500 included / metered beyond), and a one-time PS for dashboards. Ben proposed 18% for 12 months if they take the incident capture add-on, 20% for 24 months.

Kim: please review the incident-capture language in the attached SOW (AtlasHealth_SOW_v1.pdf). Specifically: how we describe data retention of ephemeral captures and the escalation path for incident investigations. We need to ensure we don't expose broad data export obligations.

Jordan: can you confirm the 500 included captures won't materially impact latency under AtlasHealth's projected QPS? They will likely run spikes during incident windows.

If legal/tech sign off, I'll present the consolidated monthly examples to procurement and request a PO template as a single-line SKU.

Thanks,
Grace

Grace / Ben —

Thanks for the options and the sensitivity scenarios — those helped a lot. Procurement reviewed and is comfortable proceeding on the 12-month consolidated SKU if Redwood will: 

- Confirm the 500 incident captures/mo as part of the service (ephemeral capture retention policy to be included in SOW);
- Provide a one-line consolidated monthly figure and a one-time invoice credit on month 1 reflecting the agreed 18% discount;
- Amortize the $4,000 dashboard PS fee across the first 6 invoices (if you can show that on the one-line template, even better).

We are ready to proceed pending a final SOW and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. Can you send the DocuSign link and the final SOW today? Procurement would like a kickoff the week of July 5.

DocuSign note: procurement prefers a single envelope that lists "AtlasHealth, Inc." as the signing party and references PO # to be issued after signature.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Natalie Russell
Director, Platform Reliability
AtlasHealth
